articles.title_en: Miroshnik called Drapaty’s appointment a compromise between Zelensky and the West
articles.lead_en: The Ambassador at Large of the Russian Foreign Ministry said that Vladimir Zelensky wanted to keep Alexander Syrsky, but was forced to move due to political, public and international pressure organized by Western liberal circles
articles.title_raw: Мирошник назвал назначение Драпатого компромиссом Зеленского и Запада
